summary.headline: Planetary Pairings and Their Effects
summary.text: Astrological delineations of planetary pairings: Zeus with Ares, Aphrodite, and Hermes, followed by Aphrodite with the Sun, Moon, and Ares, describing effects on status, wealth, marriage, children, friendships, conduct, sorcery, debts, and reputation.
